pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: wireless: Add stats for tx latency Add statistics to measure transmit latency, from packets being enqueued to wireless driver to tx status returned by firmware being processed by host driver. The stats is a histogram with exponential scale. Each bin is a count of packets with latency in that range. commit 9f6e31cb6b67 ("CHROMIUM: wireless-4.2: Add stats for tx latency.") https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/c/chromiumos/third_party/kernel/+/462403 BUG=b:122726016 TEST=cat /sys/kernel/debug/ieee80211/phyX/ath10k/tx_delay_histogram/* Change-Id: Ifb2cbd53d40d280031ea66d40dfaca8be963b871 Signed-off-by: Ratheesh S P <ratheeshs@google.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1677132 Tested-by: Ratheesh Selvakumar Pappa <ratheeshs@google.com> Commit-Ready: Ratheesh Selvakumar Pappa <ratheeshs@google.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Danny Mitzel <mitzel@google.com> Reviewed-by: Kan Yan <kyan@chromium.org>

tast: Simplify installing build dependencies. In other CLs we put build time dependencies of all Tast related binaries to chromeos-base/tast-build-deps. This CL simplifies the logic of installing build dependencies in the tast command assuming we just need to check a single fixed package. BUG=chromium:940761 TEST=fast_build.sh -T TEST=fast_build.sh && ~/go/bin/tast run DUT example.pass TEST=cat /tmp/tast/results/latest/timing.json Cq-Depend: chromium:1660509 Change-Id: Ic6a0a4517ee89d7160fa450ee2ae2dfd3941d188 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1660379 Tested-by: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Shuhei Takahashi <nya@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Hidehiko Abe <hidehiko@chromium.org>

tast: Disable cgo on building Tast binaries. Also disable PIE because it does not work without cgo: https://github.com/golang/go/issues/30986#issuecomment-475626018 Consequently, we also end up disabling ASLR for Tast binaries. This should be okay since Tast binaries are not shipped to users. cros-kernel2.eclass: Fix test builds For test builds (USE=buildtest"), the files referenced as ${old_config}" and "${old_defconfig}" do not exist unless there was a previous non-test build. "rm" on non-existing files results in an error, which in turn results in test build failures. Use "rm -f" to fix the problem. Test builds are not currently used by any autobuilders, so refrain from updating the various kernel ebuild files. BUG=None TEST="USE='-clang buildtest' emerge-eve chromeos-kernel-4_19" or similar Change-Id: Iaaadca3185344bd09c23ecf9691cb6f0171c0feb Signed-off-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1679102 Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
